en.bdb: Description of the power of the Lord

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਪਸਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਾਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau pasaau kar oa(n)kaar keeaa paasaaraa|

en.bdb: From one sound, the Oankar created the entire creation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਅਤੁਲ ਨ ਤੋਲੀਐ ਤੁਲਿ ਨ ਤੋਲ ਨ ਤੋਲਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kudharat atul na toleeaai tul na tol na tolanahaaraa|

en.bdb: His sport of creation is immeasurable. None is there who can take its measure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਅਲੇਖ ਦਾ ਦਾਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਕਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: sir sir lekh alekh dhaa dhaat jot vaddiaaiee kaaraa|

en.bdb: The writ has been inscribed on the forehead of each creature; light, grandeur and action are all due to His grace.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੇਖ ਅਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਮਸੁ ਨ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਲਿਖਣਿਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: lekh alekh na lakheeaai mas na lekhan likhanihaaraa|

en.bdb: His writ is imperceptible; the writer and His inl are also invisible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh anahadh dhunee oa(n)kaar na gaavanahaaraa|

en.bdb: Various musics, tones and rythms ate ever on but even rthen the Onkaar cannot be properly serenaded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਣੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤੁ ਨਾਵ ਥਾਉ ਅਣਗਣਤ ਆਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: khaanee baanee jeea ja(n)t naav thaau anaganat aapaaraa|

en.bdb: Mines, speeches, creatures names and places are infinite and uncountable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਕਵਾਉ ਅਮਾਉ ਹੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਵਡਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: eik kavaau amaau hai kevadd vaddaa sirajanahaaraa|

en.bdb: His one sound is beyond all limits; how expansive that creator is cannot be explained .
That true Guru , formless Lord is there and available in the holy congregation (alone)
